description: Migrate a Linux host to a new OS version by syncing data to a pre-provisioned dest, cutting over traffic, and scheduling decommission of the old host.

source_asset_id.label: Source Asset ID
source_asset_id.description: Asset ID of the old host currently serving traffic

dest_asset_id.label: Dest Asset ID
dest_asset_id.description: Asset ID of the new host (agent installed, app configured)

sync_paths.label: Sync Paths
sync_paths.description: Paths to rsync from source to dest, e.g. ["/var/lib/app", "/etc/app"]

pre_sync_runs.label: Pre-Sync Runs
pre_sync_runs.description: Run rsync N times before cutover to drain delta (default 1)

health_check_command.label: Health Check Command
health_check_command.description: Shell command run on dest to verify app health, e.g. "curl -sf http://localhost/health"

health_check_ports.label: Health Check Ports
health_check_ports.description: TCP ports that must be listening on dest before cutover

cutover_method.label: Cutover Method
cutover_method.description: Traffic swap method: eip | alb | dns | static_ip

cutover_config.label: Cutover Config
cutover_config.description: Method-specific config (see docs for schema per method)

decommission_after_hours.label: Decommission After Hours
decommission_after_hours.description: Hours to wait before terminating source (0 = manual only, default 24)

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: If true, run preflight + sync report only, no cutover

rollback.description: Reverse traffic cutover, restart source, cancel decommission job if pending
